precount_reconciliation.note: the pre-registered candidate coverage of the four carbonyl/sulfonyl families is reproduced exactly by the frozen unified class-2/3 donor rule; the two aromatic families are reproduced exactly by the legacy class-2-only donor census (11/12 cells, arylamine/train pairs 290 vs 293), i.e. the pre-registered aromatic numbers were generated with the stricter legacy donor restriction. The round uses the frozen unified rule, so the aromatic candidate coverage is larger than the pre-registered number. No definition was changed after any effect was observed.
